description: Projects multi-turn persona decay and output drift from a static systemPrompt across simulated turns (1–100) and LLM temperature (0.0–1.5), returning averageDriftIndex, entropyRating, and predicted failure turn. Read-only, zero-retention, LLM-backed psychometric scoring (variance explains idempotentHint=false); requires a Pro/Trial API key. Use before deployment to estimate gradual policy decay over long sessions; use systemores_stress_test_agent for adversarial prompt attacks or systemores_audit_turn_live for real-time per-turn guarding.

systemPrompt.description: The target agent's system prompt. Maximum 8,000 characters.

temperature.description: The LLM temperature parameter for the target agent (0.0–1.5). Higher values increase drift probability.

turns.description: The number of conversational turns to simulate (1–100).

name: systemores_evaluate_drift
title: Evaluate Multi-Turn Behavioral Drift
